name: codex-to-manuscript
description: Turn a Codex + Outline package into a publish-ready manuscript. Lets you choose your Claude model (Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, or Haiku 4.5), auto-detects genre, applies matching guardrails, runs integrity gates every 3 chapters, includes the full editorial pipeline plus a holistic whole-book polish pass. Outputs a manuscript .docx plus KDP metadata.
